svg.title: Stack
svg.desc: Technologies grouped by purpose. Filled markers are used in the case files above; hollow markers are used in smaller, unfinished or private work; dashed markers are still being learned. Languages: TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, SQL, PHP; Frontend: React, Next.js, Vite, Tailwind CSS; Backend: Node.js, Express, FastAPI, REST API design, JWT, Google OAuth, Razorpay webhooks, Server-Sent Events; Data: PostgreSQL, Supabase and RLS, MongoDB, Mongoose, Prisma, MySQL and MariaDB; Testing: Vitest, PGlite, React Testing Library, axe-core; Delivery: Docker, GitHub Actions, nginx, Vercel, Render; AI and signal: Gemini API, Beat This!, Basic Pitch, mir_eval; Learning: distributed systems (learning), observability (learning), retrieval and search (learning), queues: Redis, BullMQ (learning)
